t: 据说君士坦丁大帝收到了他著名的十字架异象。
te: Constantine the Great is said to have received his famous Vision of the Cross.
dz: 据说君士坦丁大帝收到了他著名的十字架异象。
de: Constantine the Great is said to have received his famous Vision of the Cross.

t: 君士坦丁一世在米尔维安桥之战中击败马克森提乌斯，成为西方唯一的罗马皇帝。
te: Constantine I defeats Maxentius in the battle of the Milvian Bridge, becoming the sole Roman emperor in the West.
dz: 君士坦丁一世在米尔维安桥之战中击败马克森提乌斯，成为西方唯一的罗马皇帝。
de: Constantine I defeats Maxentius in the battle of the Milvian Bridge, becoming the sole Roman emperor in the West.

te: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the…
dz: 君士坦丁大帝在米尔维安桥战役胜利后进入罗马，在城中上演了一场盛大的冒险，受到了民众的欢呼。马克森提乌斯的尸体被从台伯河中打捞出来并被斩首。
de: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the city, and is met with popular jubilation. Maxentius' body is fished out of the Tiber and beheaded.
